visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark brown hair and a fringe is seated in a brightly lit indoor living room, wearing beige satin pajamas. While she prepares to speak, a hand from an off-screen person uses a curling iron on her hair and combs through sections. (2) The scene transitions to a digital phone interface overlay displaying a Dior product unboxing video, then cuts back to the woman holding two silver Dior makeup compacts. (3) Close-up shots follow, showing her face with shimmering makeup applied to her cheeks and forehead, alternating with arm swatches of shimmering powder under different lighting conditions. (4) She is seen smelling her arm while colorful floral emojis pop up around her, followed by a sequence where a makeup artist's hand applies powder to her T-zone, cheekbones, and inner corners of her eyes using various brushes. (5) The video concludes with a stylized montage of the woman posing confidently, accompanied by sparkling graphic effects and a final frame showing the two product compacts against a pink checkered background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female Mandarin voice delivering a product recommendation at a rapid pace. A light, upbeat electronic pop track with a steady 4/4 rhythm plays at a moderate volume in the background. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers as text graphics appear on screen, followed by a 'whoosh' transition effect as the audio cuts to a closer perspective. (3) A brief, lower-pitched male voice enters for a short dramatic impersonation of a husband's reaction, characterized by an exaggerated, questioning tone. (4) The audio returns to the female narrator, who continues with high emotional valence and arousal, punctuated by 'pop' and 'sparkle' UI sound effects coinciding with makeup application demonstrations. (5) The master track concludes with a final 'ding' effect and a gradual fade of the background music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional beauty review designed to showcase the aesthetic appeal, scent, and functional performance of Dior's highlighters. By combining high-energy narration, close-up visual evidence of skin texture improvement, and relatable social anecdotes (husband's reaction), the creator aims to persuade viewers of the product's premium value and efficacy.
